notes.title: Future Plans & Update 3 Information!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello once again everyone![/h1]
We're sorry for the radio silence, we've been handling some things behind the scenes after the Unity incident a few months ago, but now It's time to talk about the future of Run a Café, as well as the next big update for Run a Café!

[h1]The Future Plans of Run a Café[/h1]
1) First thing first, we're wanting to try to [b]bring the experimental branch to Epic Games![/b] 

The experimental branch is meant for public testing of new features we want to bring into the next big update, so we want everyone able to experience it!

And finding bugs.. like this one!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AtAwMFM.gif[/img]
with that being said, we're also wanting to release more frequent experimental branch updates!

2) The next update coming out will be a SMALLER one! This one will mainly be focused on some minor QoL things, some balance changes, and some changes based on feedback from our discord!

Speaking of discord, if you haven't joined it yet... you should![url=discord.gg/pFfUNsccDy] Join our Discord![/url]

[h1]Update 3 Information![/h1]
Now... to give some light into what's going to be releasing in Update 3!

[b]Update 3 will be focused on the 4 C's : Customization, Cleaning, Café Management, and the Café itself![/b]

[i]Please note, there may be changes between this post and the actual release![/i]

Lets dive deeper into it!

[h2]Customization[/h2]
We want each player to have the ability to make their café feel like more of their own, by adding the option to change how the tables look, the paintings look, add decorations, change wall color, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868798/3703640e52bc6ff3270371c11a80a9eb27f1945c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cleaning[/h2]
Customers (as well as you) will start being able to make messes, such as accidentally spilling coffee, leaving wrappers, and other things!
This will be your job to clean it up to keep your Café rating up!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G7rQoIt.gif[/img]

[h2]Café Management[/h2]
We also want to make it easier to help manage your Café! So, we're going to be overhauling the computer! To split items up by websites, as well add a new site that will allow you to view your Café stats, and run discounts to try to bring in more customers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868798/9d7ebeca52640417d2df37c533191299e38dc760.jpg[/img]

[h2]Café[/h2]
We know sometimes for the current Café can be difficult for some people, and that's fine! We're looking into a way to control the difficulty in this update, which is why we're going to be adding a 2nd Café Variant! This one will be smaller, and easier to manage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43868798/d37924b029568f57f2e6f6d8992abfbc440df110.png[/img]

[h1]Closing Thoughts[/h1]
Once again, we'd like to apologize for going radio silent while we figured out how we wanted to approach everything again after the whole Unity incident a few months back!

Thank you all for the support, and we hope to make the Café running experience more fun and enjoyable!

- Jess

notes.title: Introducing... The Unstable Branch! | 23B1-P0 Patch notes
notes.notes:
That's right! We're releasing a new branch for you all to enjoy! 
Introducing... The "Unstable Branch"! This branch can be accessed by right clicking on Run a Café in steam, and navigate to Properties > Betas > Beta Participation > Unstable.

We will be updating this build more frequently with much smaller updates that show off some new features that are in development for a future update! From this, we will be able to get all your feedback from these smaller builds to improve the features with community feedback before releasing a feature to the live build!

With that, Here are the patch notes for the first Unstable Branch!



[h1]23B1-P0 | Spilling and Cleaning[/h1]
[h2]New :[/h2]
Messes :
[list]
[*] Filled Coffee Cups & The bucket will spills out their contents when tipped over (measuring cup to be added later)
[/list]
Items :
[list]
[*] Rag
[list]
[*] Can be wet from sink or bucket
[*] 1 use before it has to be wet from the sink or bucket again
[/list]
[*] Mop
[list]
[*] Must be wet from the bucket
[*] 3 uses before it has to be wet from the bucket again
[/list]
[*] Bucket
[list]
[*] Can be filled from the sink
[*] Has 3 uses before it has to get re-filled
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
Misc :
[list]
[*] The buttons on the shop screen will now dissapear when using Keyboard & Mouse
[/list]

notes.title: Customer Overhaul Update | 0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We're so excited to release this update, which DOUBLES if not TRIPLES the amount of content in the game!

[h1]New :[/h1]
[h3]Game Over :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Rent to the game
[i]We've re-added the game over screen, now you'll have to pay rent at the end of each day. As you get upgrades, your rent will slowly increase! Failure to pay your rent at the end of the day, will result in a game over![/i]
Rent Values :
[list]
[*] Base Café : $25
[*] Upgrade 1 : $30
[*] Upgrade 2 : $35
[*] Upgrade 3 : $45
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Café Menu :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upon unlocking the first shop upgrade, you will now unlock a new sign that'll be over the counters, upon interacting with it, the player will be able to change what customers can order!
[/list]

[h3]Save/Load System | 2.0 :[/h3]
[i]With this update we've overhauled the entire saving and loading system from the ground up! With 2.0 of the save system, we've cut back on saving and loading times massively, however, this means that saves from 0.1.2 and back will no longer work. However, we're hoping this will be the last time we have to overhaul the save/load system for a long time![/i]

Examples :
[list]
Early Game :
[list]
Saving | 15s to 30s -> 5s to 10s
Loading | 30s to 45s -> 5s to 10s
[/list]
Mid Game :
[list]
Saving | 2m to 2m 30s -> 15s to 30s
Loading | 3m 30s to 4m -> 10s to 15s
[/list]
Late Game :
[list]
Saving | 5m to 6m -> 10s to 30s
Loading | 7m to 10m -> 15s -> 25s
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Save Options :[/h3]
[list]
New Modes :
[list]
[*] Career Mode
[i]This mode contains the new rent mechanic, and game over mechanic! Try your best to run your cafe and keep it open![/i]

[*] Free Mode
[i]Don't like the game over and rent mechanic? Worry not! This mode works just like the game did in previous versions, run your café with no worry of rent or getting a game over![/i]
[/list]
[*] Added new save icons
[/list]

[h3]Tables :[/h3]
[*] You can now buy table upgrades from the shop! When the player has some tables, the customers can now decide between waiting in line, or sitting at a table!
[*] If the customer sits at the table, they have a chance to order multiple times!

[h3]Paintings :[/h3]
[i] Add a new visual flare to your café![/i]

[h3]Music :[/h3]
[list]
Added new music :
[list]
[*] "Pourover" by AshleyPotatoMashley
[*] "Where's my Coffee" by AshleyPotatoMashley
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Shop Upgrade #3 :[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2nd Floor appears!
[*] More Paintings!
[*] More Tables!
New Coffee Flavors :
[list]
[*] White Chocolate
[*] Liquid Sweetener
[i] While White Chocolate still acts the same when customers order a drink with it, Liquid Sweetener will be ordered differently! When enabled via the Café Menu, the customer will have a chance to ask for 1 to 4 pumps of sweetener to be added to their coffee![/i]
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Rendering :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Occlusion Culling
[i]Rendering Occlusion has been added! This addition will increase framerates drastically! [/i]
[/list]

[h3]Items :[/h3]
[list]
Dolly :
[i]Hated how long it took to travel from the pallets to the counter? How about we cut that down! This new item will allow you to store boxes on it, open or closed![/i]

Table Tray :
[i]We've also added a tray! You can place coffee cups and food on the tray, and carry it to tables! You can also interact with it using <E> to select what table you're making the order for![/i]

Jukebox :
[i]The Jukebox will allow the player to swap between different music tracks, and will spawn in upon buying the 2nd shop upgrade![/i]
[/list]

[h3]Graphical Overhaul :[/h3]
[list]
[i]You read that right! In this update, we also upgraded some of our texturing and lighting in the game![/i]
[*] Added more detail to the walls, floor, glass, grass, etc.
[*] Changed the brightness of all flavor pumps
[*] Changed the material of the Iced Coffee Cups to feel more plastic than glass
and more..!
[/list]

[h3]Settings :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebinding
[i]You read that right! We've implemented rebinding for keyboard and mouse![/i]

[*] Resolutions

[*] Full-screen

[*] Auto-Save
[i]In-between days, the game will auto-save, so if you happen to game over, you can return to the previous auto-save and try again! This option is enabled by default, but can be turned off in the <Game> tab in the settings menu[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Misc :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added more Coffee Recipes
[*] When the front door opens, a bell will play
[/list]


[h1]Changes :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the resolution of the shop images
[*] When a box is empty, the image will now disappear
[*] When placing a completed coffee/food into the order zone, it will change the name of the coffee/food to green if it's correct
[*] Added some more textures for customers to add a bit more variation
[*] Balanced the amount of time all customers will wait
[*] Customers wait time will now also be affected by the level of the Player's Café
[*] The rate at which Customers spawn will now be affected by the level of the Player's Café
[*] Customers spawn chance will change depending on how many customers are already spawned :
[list]
[*] 1 - 3 = 80%
[*] 4 = 60%
[*] 5 = 40%
[*] 6 - 15 = 20%
[/list]
[*] Increased the max amount of cars allowed in the parking lot : 11 -> 15
[*] Players can now place items closer to them than before
[*] Optimized multiple scripts
[*] Adjusted multiple items placements outlines
[*] Adjusted all item placements
[*] Adjusted the hitboxes of ALL items
[*] Players can no longer place items where they normally wouldn't fit
[*] The game no longer pauses when alt + tabbing
[*] Updated the placement of some objects in the main menu
[*] Replaced the logo at the main menu with the early access version
[*] Updated the Credits on the Main Menu
[*] Made the light in the janitor's closet centered
[*] The Café will start more run down at the start, and each upgrade will liven up the Café
[*] Rebound the emergency save button : P -> NUMPAD *
[*] Increased the speed of cars pulling in
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes :[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where purchasing55 the 2nd shelves upgrade wouldn't move any items that were by the shelves out of the way
[*] Fixed a bug where buying shop upgrade #2 would move boxes that were in the area or on where the shelves #2 upgrade would be
[*] Fixed a bug with item layering
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the game to sometimes break if you accept multiple orders at once
[*] Fixed a bug where dumping an iced coffee cup into the sink, could cause the game to lock-up
[*] Fixed a bug where pulling an item out of a box while holding another item, would cause the game to spit out an error
[*] Fixed a bug where pouring a cup of coffee using a coffee pot whose coffee was no longer hot/cold, it would still pour hot/cold coffee
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented ice from appearing in iced coffee cups
[*] Fixed a bug where if the player only bought the muffins, upon re-loading they would be locked again until the player bought a 2nd upgrade
[*] Fixed a bug where the item outlines would lag behind where the player was looking
[*] Fixed a bug where interacting with a customer that's leaving would still cause the timer to popup, but no order
[*] Fixed a bug where pouring coffee from a dirty pot into an iced coffee cup, would change the texture of the iced coffee cup to a dirty normal coffee cup
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could fill up a coffee cup with flavor pumps, and then place it back on the cup stack and get a fresh cup
[/list]
